Given the sets $P={1,2,3,4}$ and  $S={2,3,4,5,6}$ shown above, find $P-S.$

feedback.worked_solution:
The difference $S-T$ consists of all the elements that are in $S$ but not $T.$ To represent $S-T,$ we will shade in all the area that is contained in $S$ but not $T.$

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/linear/14037357/assets/c3694dbc8f5eb9bdaf352fc3d456c6dabc07224f18e73257a9030000e5b1263e.png)

The elements $a$ and $b$ are in $S$ but not $T.$

Therefore, the difference is

$$
S-T={a,b}.
$$
